channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Conroy recommits to Galway
item.description: Paul Conroy has handed the Galway footballers a major boost by returning to training.

item.title: Residents unhappy at parking chaos during Donegal v Mayo clash
item.description: Residents of a housing estate in Letterkenny have hit out at the parking congestion caused by supporters attending last Sunday's Allianz Football League game between Donegal and Mayo in O'Donnell Park.

item.title: McGinley predicts impact sub role for Murphy
item.description: Enda McGinley expects Donegal manager Jim McGuinness to use Michael Murphy as an impact sub this season.

item.title: Rossies welcome back St Brigid's contingent
item.description: Roscommon have been boosted by the return of their St Brigid's contingent ahead of Saturday evening's Allianz Football League local derby with Galway in Salthill.

item.title: Six of the best from super-sub McNulty
item.description: Barry McNulty has been honoured after landing an incredible six two-pointers in the second half of Leitrim's Allianz Football League Division 4 victory over London last Sunday.

item.title: Roscommon LGFA rocked by resignations
item.description: Roscommon LGFA has been plunged into crisis after four members of its executive stepped down.

item.title: Brolly takes charge of Knockmore ladies
item.description: Joe Brolly has been appointed as the new Knockmore senior ladies football manager.

item.title: 2026 Mayo football championship draws made
item.description: The draws have taken place for the 2026 Mayo adult football championships.

item.title: Bugler convinced transitional Dubs can win Sam
item.description: Sean Bugler believes Dublin can win the All-Ireland SFC title this year, despite being in heavy transition.

item.title: Costello set to miss Cork clash
item.description: Meath are expected to be without Mathew Costello for Sunday's Allianz Football League Division 2 top-of-the-table showdown with Cork at Páirc Uí Rinn.
